# Crayon Roofing & Structures — Sales Call Knowledge Base (auto-distilled)

## Corpus summary
The dataset is a large block of concatenated call snippets, but only a modest subset are genuine **sales** conversations — inbound/outbound enquiries about roofing sheets, screws, welding rods, polycarbonate sheets, puff panels and accessories, plus a handful of dealer/price-negotiation and payment-collection calls. A large share of the file is **not sales**: Diwali-gift distribution logistics, vehicle/loading/driver coordination, attendance/location check-ins, bill-copy handovers, and many duplicated/garbled fragments. This KB is built only from the calls where a customer/dealer is asking about product, rate, quantity, delivery or raising an objection.

Given the volume of noise, the real sales signal is thinner than the transcript count suggests — most "deals" are small (1 box of screws, a few sheets, one coil) and the company's core sales motion is reactive (inbound WhatsApp/phone enquiry → rate quote → WhatsApp quotation) rather than a scripted pitch. Treat the patterns below as representative, not exhaustive.

## Products & brand ladder
Crayon Roofing & Structures (factory at Manali, Andarkuppam check post, Chennai) sells:

- **Metal roofing sheets (core product)** — color-coated profile/trapezoidal sheets in thickness 0.45 mm to 0.6/0.7 mm (0.7 mm generally **not in stock**, max is 0.6 mm per one call: "0.7 mm-ல இல்ல Sir, 0.6 mm-ல sky blue available").
  - **JSW Color On Plus** — flagship/premium brand, most quoted: "420 + GST square meter rate" / "445 + GST square meter rate sir."
  - **JSW Pragathi (Pragati)** — slightly above Color On Plus in one quote ("Pragathi color of plus madam 445 + GST"), but also quoted lower elsewhere (410+GST) — rates clearly fluctuate by date/coil.
  - **JSW Radiance, Silver-On** — other JSW sub-brands; staff sometimes confuse which is costlier ("Silver-on கொஞ்சம் விலை அதிகம், JSW Steel கொஞ்சம் விலை கம்மி").
  - **Asian / Indra Dhanush (AZ 150 GSM, ISI marked)** — value brand: "Asian Force .45 இந்திர தனுஷ் 370+ GST" and a 10 ft sheet at "₹1251 + 18% GST."
  - Colors on offer: Sky Blue, Royal Blue, Off-White/Half White, Dark Green ("Kali Sheet Green").
- **Accessories**: L-flash, ridge, gutter, crimp, cutters (standard width 610 mm; wider custom cuts cost double — "610 mm-க்குள்ள 655, அதுக்கு மேல போச்சுனா full sheet rate"), bends (9 inch bend etc.).
- **Puff insulated panels** (separate factory/line) — wall & roof panels, typically 50 mm thickness, sold by running meter: "₹1650 + tax square meter," roughly "₹2000" all-in running meter including GST.
- **Polycarbonate sheets** (brand Lexan) — 1.5, 1.8, 2 mm stock thickness; **10 mm and other thickness are custom/consult-only**; standard max length 15 ft; rate example "800 + GST square meter" (2mm) and "clear 10 mm ₹61+tax/square feet."
- **Screws** — Tata brand self-drilling/self-tapping ("Agri-Go," full-thread FD), common sizes 1 inch, 2 inch (rust-free variant also), M8-55mm. Sample rates: 1 inch ₹2.93+tax, 2 inch ₹4.44–4.66+tax (dealer vs consumer price differs).
- **Welding rods** — Tata and "Rasi" brands, sold by carton/packet with periodic rate hikes and scheme/gift promotions for volume buyers.
- **MS Channels / Structures (JSW brand)** — occasionally enquired, often routed to a dedicated contact ("Channel details எல்லாம் சொல்லுவாரு").

**What they explicitly do NOT make / don't stock** (important for setting expectations):
- Liner sheets — "நம்ம இதுல பண்ணவே இல்லையே," customers referred to Arumuga Steel/Thiruvannamalai producers.
- Tile-profile sheets — made by other machine owners (Amar, Everlast), not Crayon.
- UPVC sheets — "UPVC நம்மகிட்ட available இல்லை sir. Metal roofing sheet தான் இருக்குது."
- MS corrugated 1.2 mm — same answer, "நம்ம metal roofing sheet தான் சார் பண்ணிட்டு இருக்கோம்."
- GI sheet with specific GSM grades (80/120 GSM, "regular spangle") — team has to check internally; they mainly supply color-coated metal roofing, not raw GI.

## Real rates & terms (only rates that actually appear in the calls)
- JSW Color On Plus 0.47 mm: **₹420 + GST/sq m** and **₹445 + GST/sq m** (quoted on different calls).
- JSW Pragathi: **₹445 + GST/sq m**; another call: **₹410 + GST/sq m**.
- Asian Indra Dhanush / Force 0.45: **₹370 + GST/sq m**.
- Kg-based pricing (used for small/retail buyers): **₹118–₹120/kg + GST**.
- 10 ft JSW sheet: **₹1,466 + 18% GST per sheet**.
- 10 ft Asian Indra Dhanush 0.45 mm sheet: **₹1,251 + 18% GST + loading charge**.
- Cutter/L-flash: standard 610 mm girth = **₹655**; beyond 610 mm = full-sheet/double rate.
- Puff panel: **₹1,650 + tax/sq m** (~₹2,000 all-in running meter, GST-inclusive, as told to a fabricator).
- Polycarbonate 2 mm: **₹800 + GST/sq m**; clear 10 mm: **₹61 + tax/sq ft**.
- Screws: 1 inch **₹2.93 + tax**, 2 inch **₹4.44–₹4.66 + tax** (price differs for dealer vs end-customer — "Dealer price-ஆ இல்ல consumer price-ஆ sir?").
